sentences.en: A Bronze Age shipwreck was found in the Mediterranean sea.
sentences.zh: 在地中海发现了一艘青铜时代的沉船。

sentences.en: A bad wife is the shipwreck of her husband.
sentences.zh: 一个不好的妻子是她丈夫的灾难（此处比喻为海难）。

sentences.en: A bad wife turns her husband into a shipwreck.
sentences.zh: 一个不好的妻子让她的丈夫陷入困境（此处比喻为遭遇海难）
